classes.name: Object
classes.description: The base of every class. Every object knows its class and reports when a property changes.

properties.name: ClassName
properties.description: The name of the object's class, such as "Folder". It cannot be changed.

methods.name: IsA
methods.description: Returns true if the object's class is the given class or inherits from it, such as part:IsA("WorldObject").

signals.name: Changed
signals.description: Fires after one of the object's properties changes, with the property's name.

classes.name: Instance
classes.description: The base of everything in the game tree. An instance has a name and a parent, can be searched, copied and destroyed, and can carry custom attributes.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: The instance's name. Names do not have to be unique; FindFirstChild returns the first match.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: The instance this one sits under, or nil when it is outside the game. Setting it moves the instance.

properties.name: Archivable
properties.description: Whether the instance is copied by Clone and saved with the game. Turn it off for temporary objects.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Removes the instance and everything under it from the game for good. It cannot be used again afterwards.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the instance and everything under it, with no parent. Returns nil when Archivable is off; children with Archivable off are left out.

methods.name: GetChildren
methods.description: Returns a list of the instances directly under this one, in order.

methods.name: GetDescendants
methods.description: Returns a list of every instance under this one, at any depth, parents before their children.

methods.name: FindFirstChild
methods.description: Returns the first child with the given name, or nil. Pass true as the second argument to search every descendant.

methods.name: FindFirstChildOfClass
methods.description: Returns the first child whose class is exactly the given class, or nil. Subclasses do not count; use FindFirstChildWhichIsA for that.

methods.name: FindFirstChildWhichIsA
methods.description: Returns the first child whose class is the given class or inherits from it, or nil. Pass true as the second argument to search every descendant.

methods.name: FindFirstAncestor
methods.description: Returns the nearest instance above this one with the given name, or nil.

methods.name: IsDescendantOf
methods.description: Returns true if this instance is somewhere under the given instance.

methods.name: IsAncestorOf
methods.description: Returns true if the given instance is somewhere under this one.

methods.name: GetFullName
methods.description: Returns the instance's path of names from its service down, separated by dots, such as "Workspace.Map.Door".

methods.name: ClearAllChildren
methods.description: Destroys every child of the instance (and everything under them). The instance itself stays.

methods.name: GetAttribute
methods.description: Returns the value of the attribute with the given name, or nil when it is not set.

methods.name: SetAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute: a custom named value stored on the instance and saved with it. Setting nil removes it. Attributes hold booleans, numbers, strings, vectors, CFrames, colours and enum items, not instances.

methods.name: GetAttributes
methods.description: Returns every attribute of the instance as a table of names to values.

signals.name: ChildAdded
signals.description: Fires after an instance is placed directly under this one.

signals.name: ChildRemoved
signals.description: Fires after an instance directly under this one is moved away or destroyed.

signals.name: DescendantAdded
signals.description: Fires after an instance is placed anywhere under this one, at any depth.

signals.name: DescendantRemoving
signals.description: Fires just before an instance anywhere under this one is moved away or destroyed.

signals.name: AncestryChanged
signals.description: Fires when this instance or one of its ancestors gets a new parent, with the instance that moved and its new parent (nil when it left the game).

signals.name: AttributeChanged
signals.description: Fires after an attribute is set, changed or removed, with the attribute's name.

signals.name: Destroying
signals.description: Fires when the instance is about to be destroyed, while it is still intact.

classes.name: BindableEvent
classes.description: A signal that scripts fire themselves: one script calls Fire, and every function connected to Event runs with the same arguments. It works between scripts on the same side (server or client).

methods.name: Fire
methods.description: Fires Event with all the arguments given. Listeners run later in the frame, not inside Fire; when nothing is connected, nothing happens.

signals.name: Event
signals.description: Fires when Fire is called, with the arguments passed to Fire.

classes.name: BindableFunction
classes.description: A function that one script exposes and others call: a script assigns a function to OnInvoke, and Invoke calls it and returns what it returns. It works between scripts on the same side (server or client).

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Calls the function assigned to OnInvoke with all the arguments given and returns its results. The calling script waits while the function runs, even if it yields. If no function is assigned yet, the caller waits until one is; an error in the function is raised in the caller.

callbacks.name: OnInvoke
callbacks.description: The function Invoke calls. Assign a function to it (or nil to remove it); it receives Invoke's arguments, and what it returns is what Invoke returns. It cannot be read.

classes.name: DataModel
classes.description: The whole game (`game` in scripts). Its children are the services, such as Workspace and Lighting.

methods.name: GetService
methods.description: Returns the service with the given class name, such as game:GetService("Lighting"). It always returns the same instance for a service.

classes.name: Folder
classes.description: A container for organising instances. It has no position and does nothing on its own.

classes.name: InputObject
classes.description: One input: a press of a key or mouse button, a finger on the screen, the mouse's movement or the wheel. UserInputService's InputBegan, InputChanged and InputEnded pass one. Each press is a new object that goes from Begin to End and is then destroyed (it stays readable while you hold it), so a table keyed by input objects tracks what is held. Mouse movement and the wheel reuse one object each, updated every frame.

properties.name: KeyCode
properties.description: The key, for keyboard input; Unknown for every other kind.

properties.name: UserInputType
properties.description: What kind of input this is: a key, a mouse button, mouse movement, the wheel or a touch.

properties.name: UserInputState
properties.description: Where the input is: Begin, Change, End or Cancel.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Where the input is, in physical pixels from the window's top-left corner (X right, Y down): the cursor for keys, mouse buttons and movement, the finger for a touch. For the wheel, Z is how many notches it turned this frame (positive away from the user).

properties.name: Delta
properties.description: How far the input moved since the last frame: raw mouse movement for MouseMovement (it keeps coming while the cursor is locked), pixels for a touch. Zero for keys and buttons.

properties.name: NextInput
properties.description: Engine bookkeeping: the next held key's input object (see UserInputService.FirstInput).

classes.name: Lighting
classes.description: Controls how the scene is lit: the time of day, the sun and moon, the colours of the sky and the ambient light.

properties.name: ClockTime
properties.description: The time of day in hours, which places the sun: 6 is sunrise, 12 is noon, 18 is sunset. Values wrap around the clock instead of stopping at the ends: 25 becomes 1 and -1 becomes 23, so a script can simply add to it to run the day.

properties.name: TimeOfDay
properties.description: ClockTime written as hours, minutes and seconds, such as "14:30:00" (hours 0-23, seconds optional when writing). Setting it sets ClockTime; a text that is not a time is an error.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.description: How strong the sunlight is (and the moonlight, at night). 0 turns the sun off.

properties.name: GeographicLatitude
properties.description: Where on Earth the game is, in degrees north of the equator. It sets how high the sun climbs: at 0 it passes straight overhead at noon, further north it stays lower in the south.

properties.name: SunDirection
properties.description: The direction from the scene towards the sun, a unit vector set by ClockTime and GeographicLatitude. It points below the horizon at night, when the moon, opposite it, lights the scene.

properties.name: GlobalShadows
properties.description: Whether the sun, and the moon at night, cast shadows. Each part can still opt out with its own CastShadow. Turning it off saves the cost of drawing the shadows.

properties.name: SkyColor
properties.description: The colour of the sky overhead in the middle of the day. It also tints the light from the sky.

properties.name: HorizonColor
properties.description: The colour of the sky at the horizon in the middle of the day; the sky fades to it from SkyColor.

properties.name: OutdoorAmbient
properties.description: The light the sky gives outdoors, from above, filling what the sun does not reach. It dims at night and is bluer then.

properties.name: Ambient
properties.description: Light added evenly everywhere, indoors and out, at every time of day: raise it to keep dark places and nights brighter.

methods.name: GetMinutesAfterMidnight
methods.description: Returns the time of day in minutes since midnight, which is ClockTime times 60.

methods.name: SetMinutesAfterMidnight
methods.description: Sets the time of day to this many minutes after midnight. Like ClockTime it wraps around the day, so 1500 is 01:00.

methods.name: GetSunDirection
methods.description: Returns the unit vector from the scene towards the sun, the same as SunDirection.

methods.name: GetMoonDirection
methods.description: Returns the unit vector from the scene towards the moon, which is always opposite the sun.

classes.name: ReplicatedStorage
classes.description: Storage for things both the server and players need, such as shared modules and assets. Nothing here is drawn or run.

classes.name: RunService
classes.description: The engine's frame loop, seen from scripts: events that fire every frame, and whether the game runs in Studio, on a client or on the server. Get it with game:GetService("RunService").

properties.name: InStudio
properties.description: Set by the engine when the game runs inside Studio. Read it with IsStudio().

properties.name: Running
properties.description: Set by the engine while the game runs (paused included). Read it with IsRunning().

properties.name: OnClient
properties.description: Set by the engine when this side is a player's client. Read it with IsClient().

properties.name: OnServer
properties.description: Set by the engine when this side is the server. Read it with IsServer().

methods.name: IsStudio
methods.description: Returns true when the game runs inside Studio (in play mode or while editing).

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Returns true while the game runs: after it starts and until it stops. A paused game still runs.

methods.name: IsClient
methods.description: Returns true on a player's client. A standalone game, with no separate server, is both client and server.

methods.name: IsServer
methods.description: Returns true on the server. A standalone game, with no separate server, is both client and server.

signals.name: RenderStepped
signals.description: Fires every frame before the frame is drawn, before physics, with the frame's time step in seconds. Only on clients; a server never fires it. Use it for the camera and other things that must match what is drawn.

signals.name: PreSimulation
signals.description: Fires every frame just before physics steps, with the frame's time step in seconds. Use it to move things physics should see this frame.

signals.name: PostSimulation
signals.description: Fires every frame just after physics has stepped, with the frame's time step in seconds. Use it to read where physics put things.

signals.name: Heartbeat
signals.description: Fires every frame at its end, after physics, with the frame's time step in seconds. Threads waiting in task.wait resume in the same step.

classes.name: ServerScriptService
classes.description: Holds the game's server scripts. Scripts placed here run on the server; players never see them.

classes.name: ServerStorage
classes.description: Storage only the server can see, such as maps and items to copy into the world later. Nothing here is drawn or run.

classes.name: SourceContainer
classes.description: The base of every script: an instance that points at a source file in the project. The file's extension selects the language, so a game can mix languages.

properties.name: Source
properties.description: The project-relative path of the script's source file, such as "Scripts/Door.luau", chosen with a file picker. The file's extension selects the language. Empty means the script has no source and does nothing.

classes.name: UserGameSettings
classes.description: The player's graphics settings: the preset, the quality level it draws at and the values in effect. Scripts can read them, to adapt a game to the player's machine, but never change them: they are the player's. Get it with game:GetService("UserGameSettings").

properties.name: GraphicsPreset
properties.description: The graphics preset the player chose.

properties.name: QualityLevel
properties.description: The quality level drawn at, from 1 (Low) to 4 (Ultra). With the Auto preset, the level its calibration chose for this machine.

properties.name: RenderScale
properties.description: The share of the window's width and height the scene is drawn at before it is scaled to the window (0.5 to 2). With dynamic resolution, the highest scale it may use.

properties.name: DynamicResolution
properties.description: Whether the render scale changes every frame to hold the GPU frame time at TargetFrameTime.

properties.name: TargetFrameTime
properties.description: The GPU frame time dynamic resolution holds, in milliseconds.

properties.name: ViewDistance
properties.description: How far the camera sees, in metres; 0 when it sees without limit.

properties.name: ShadowQualityLevel
properties.description: The quality of the sun's shadows, from 1 (Low) to 4 (Ultra): how many shadow maps, how sharp.

properties.name: ShadowDistance
properties.description: How far from the camera the sun's shadows reach, in metres.

properties.name: LocalLightBudget
properties.description: How many point and spot lights a frame draws at full strength, the most important ones; the others fade out.

properties.name: LodBias
properties.description: How finely distant round parts are drawn: 1 keeps their outlines within half a pixel; higher is finer.

properties.name: VSync
properties.description: Whether frames wait for the display's refresh.

properties.name: FrameRateCap
properties.description: The most frames per second; 0 when uncapped.

classes.name: UserInputService
classes.description: Keyboard, mouse and touch input: events for every key, button, movement and touch, what is held right now, and how the mouse cursor behaves. Input arrives at the start of each frame. Get it with game:GetService("UserInputService").

properties.name: MouseBehavior
properties.description: How the cursor behaves. Default leaves it free; LockCenter holds it at the window's centre and LockCurrentPosition where it was when set, so mouse movement can turn a camera (read GetMouseDelta).

properties.name: MouseIconEnabled
properties.description: Whether the cursor is shown over the game's window.

properties.name: MouseEnabled
properties.description: Whether a mouse is in use. Set by the engine once mouse input arrives.

properties.name: KeyboardEnabled
properties.description: Whether a keyboard is in use. Set by the engine once keyboard input arrives.

properties.name: TouchEnabled
properties.description: Whether a touch screen is in use. Set by the engine once a touch arrives.

properties.name: GamepadEnabled
properties.description: Whether a gamepad is connected. Set by the engine as gamepads come and go.

properties.name: MouseLocation
properties.description: Engine bookkeeping: where the cursor is. Read it with GetMouseLocation().

properties.name: MouseDelta
properties.description: Engine bookkeeping: how far the mouse moved this frame. Read it with GetMouseDelta().

properties.name: HeldKeys1
properties.description: Engine bookkeeping: held keys 0 to 63, as bits by KeyCode item index. Read them with IsKeyDown().

properties.name: HeldKeys2
properties.description: Engine bookkeeping: held keys 64 to 127, as bits by KeyCode item index. Read them with IsKeyDown().

properties.name: HeldKeys3
properties.description: Engine bookkeeping: held keys 128 to 191, as bits by KeyCode item index. Read them with IsKeyDown().

properties.name: HeldButtons
properties.description: Engine bookkeeping: held mouse buttons as bits (1 is MouseButton1). Read them with IsMouseButtonPressed().

properties.name: FirstInput
properties.description: Engine bookkeeping: the first input object of the held keys, each pointing to the next. Read them with GetKeysPressed().

methods.name: IsKeyDown
methods.description: Returns true while the key is held down. A key pressed and released within one frame is down for that frame.

methods.name: IsMouseButtonPressed
methods.description: Returns true while the mouse button (UserInputType.MouseButton1, 2 or 3) is held down; false for any other input type.

methods.name: GetMouseLocation
methods.description: Returns where the cursor is, in physical pixels from the window's top-left corner.

methods.name: GetMouseDelta
methods.description: Returns how far the mouse moved during this frame, in raw mouse units (X right, Y down). It keeps counting while the cursor is locked (MouseBehavior), which is what a camera reads; it is zero in a frame without movement.

methods.name: GetKeysPressed
methods.description: Returns the input objects of every key held down right now: the same objects InputBegan passed for those presses, and InputEnded will pass.

signals.name: InputBegan
signals.description: Fires when an input begins: a key or mouse button goes down, a finger touches the screen. Each press gets a new InputObject, which InputChanged and InputEnded pass again for that press. gameProcessedEvent is true when the game's UI used the input (always false until there is game UI).

signals.name: InputChanged
signals.description: Fires when an input changes: the mouse moves (once per frame, with the frame's movement as Delta), the wheel turns, a finger moves (once per frame per finger).

signals.name: InputEnded
signals.description: Fires when an input ends: a key or mouse button is released, a finger leaves the screen, or the window loses focus while it is held. A press shorter than a frame ends in the next frame, so InputBegan always sees it begun.

signals.name: WindowFocused
signals.description: Fires when the game's window gains keyboard focus.

signals.name: WindowFocusReleased
signals.description: Fires when the game's window loses keyboard focus.

classes.name: ValueBase
classes.description: The base of the value objects: instances that store one value, such as a score or a door's target, where scripts can share it.

signals.name: Changed
signals.description: Fires after Value changes, with the new value.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.description: The 3D world: everything placed here is part of the scene. Scripts placed here run.

properties.name: CurrentCamera
properties.description: The camera the screen shows. A new game starts with one, named Camera, inside Workspace.

classes.name: WorldObject
classes.description: The base of everything that has a position in the 3D world, such as models, parts, lights and cameras.

properties.name: PivotOffset
properties.description: Where the object's pivot sits, relative to the object. Moving and rotating the object happens around its pivot.

methods.name: GetPivot
methods.description: Returns the point the object moves and rotates around, as a CFrame in world space. For a model without a PrimaryPart it is the centre of its parts.

methods.name: PivotTo
methods.description: Moves the object so that its pivot is at the given CFrame. A model moves everything in it together, keeping their positions relative to each other.

classes.name: BasePart
classes.description: The base of every solid object in the world: where it is, how big, what it looks like and how it behaves.

properties.name: CFrame
properties.description: Where the part is and how it is rotated, in world space. Position and Orientation are views of it.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Where the part's centre is, in metres. Setting it moves the part without rotating it.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: The part's rotation as angles in degrees about X, Y and Z, applied Z first, then X, then Y. Setting it rotates the part in place.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: How big the part is along X, Y and Z, in metres. Each side is kept between 0.001 and 2048.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: The part's colour.

properties.name: Material
properties.description: What the part looks like it is made of, such as Wood, Metal or Neon.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: How see-through the part is: 0 is solid, 1 is invisible.

properties.name: CastShadow
properties.description: Whether the part casts a shadow.

properties.name: Anchored
properties.description: Whether the part stays where it is. An anchored part is not moved by gravity or collisions.

properties.name: CanCollide
properties.description: Whether other parts bump into this one. When off, things pass through it.

classes.name: BaseScript
classes.description: The base of Script and LocalScript: a script that runs on its own when the game starts, if enabled.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Whether the script runs. A disabled script does not start; turning it off later stops it.

classes.name: BoolValue
classes.description: Stores true or false under a name, such as whether a door is open.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The stored true or false. Starts false.

classes.name: Camera
classes.description: A point of view on the world. The screen shows what Workspace.CurrentCamera sees.

properties.name: CFrame
properties.description: Where the camera is and which way it looks, in world space. It looks along its forward direction (-Z).

properties.name: FieldOfView
properties.description: How much the camera sees from top to bottom, in degrees. Smaller values zoom in.

classes.name: IntValue
classes.description: Stores a whole number under a name, such as a score or a count.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The stored whole number. Starts at 0.

classes.name: Light
classes.description: The base of every light: whether it is on, how bright, what colour, how far it reaches and shadows.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Whether the light shines. Turning it off keeps every other setting.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.description: How strong the light is. 1 is an ordinary lamp; 0 gives no light.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: The colour of the light.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: How far the light reaches, in metres. Past this distance it lights nothing.

properties.name: Shadows
properties.description: Whether objects block this light and cast shadows. Shadows cost performance, so use them sparingly.

properties.name: CFrame
properties.description: Where the light is and which way it points (forward is -Z). Inside a part it is relative to the part, so the light moves with it; anywhere else it is in world space.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: A group of world objects that belong together, such as a car or a house, moved and copied as one.

properties.name: PrimaryPart
properties.description: The part the model moves and rotates around. When it is nil (or not inside the model), the model pivots on the centre of its parts.

classes.name: ModuleScript
classes.description: Code shared between scripts. It runs the first time a script requires it and returns a value, usually a table of functions; later requires return that same value.

classes.name: NumberValue
classes.description: Stores a number under a name, such as a speed or an amount of health.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The stored number. Starts at 0.

classes.name: ObjectValue
classes.description: Stores a reference to another instance under a name, such as the door a button opens.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The instance it points at, or nil. Starts nil, and reads nil once that instance is destroyed.

classes.name: StringValue
classes.description: Stores text under a name, such as a team name or a message to show.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The stored text. Starts empty.

classes.name: DirectionalLight
classes.description: Parallel light from one direction over the whole world, like the sun. It points along its CFrame's forward direction and has no range.

classes.name: LocalScript
classes.description: A script that runs on each player's client, for input, the camera and the user interface. What it changes is seen only by that player.

classes.name: Part
classes.description: The basic building block: a block, ball, cylinder or wedge that you size, colour and place.

properties.name: Shape
properties.description: The part's shape. A Ball's diameter is the smallest side of Size; a Cylinder runs along X; a Wedge slopes down towards -Z.

classes.name: PointLight
classes.description: Light shining in every direction from one point, like a bulb or a torch. It reaches Range metres.

classes.name: Script
classes.description: A script that runs on the server, where it can change the game for every player. In a standalone game, which has no separate server, it runs in the single local context.

classes.name: SpotLight
classes.description: A cone of light shining forward from the light, like a torch or a stage light.

properties.name: Angle
properties.description: How wide the cone is: the full angle from one edge to the other, in degrees.

enums.name: UserInputType
enums.description: What kind of input an InputObject is: a mouse button (1 is the left, 2 the right, 3 the middle), the wheel, mouse movement, a touch or a key.

enums.name: UserInputState
enums.description: Where an input is: it began (a key or button went down, a finger touched), changed (moved), ended (released) or was cancelled by the system.

enums.name: KeyCode
enums.description: A keyboard key, named by where it sits on a US keyboard: KeyCode.W is the key where W is on QWERTY, whatever the layout prints on it. InputObject.KeyCode and UserInputService:IsKeyDown use it. Unknown is a key the computer could not identify, and the KeyCode of every input that is not a key.

enums.name: GraphicsPreset
enums.description: A graphics preset: how much a frame may cost, never what the game looks like. Auto measures the machine and holds the frame time with dynamic resolution.

enums.name: MouseBehavior
enums.description: How the mouse cursor behaves: free (Default), or held so the mouse turns the camera (LockCenter at the middle of the window, LockCurrentPosition where it is). Movement keeps arriving while it is held.

enums.name: Material
enums.description: What a part's surface is made of, which sets how it looks: its texture, shine and glow.

enums.name: PartShape
enums.description: The shape of a Part: a box, a sphere, a cylinder or a ramp.

components.name: DirectionalLightEmitter
components.description: Lights the whole world with parallel rays along the light's forward direction (-Z), however far.

components.name: PointLightEmitter
components.description: Lights everything within Range of the light's position, equally in every direction.

components.name: PrimitiveMesh
components.description: Draws the part as the built-in mesh for its Shape, stretched to its Size.

components.name: SpotLightEmitter
components.description: Lights a cone that opens Angle degrees along the light's forward direction (-Z), up to Range metres.

components.name: Transform
components.description: Places the object in the world from its CFrame property. The renderer, physics and audio read the object's world position and rotation through it.
